items.known: CKV_AWS_44 Ensure Neptune storage is securely encrypted (resource aws_neptune_cluster.default)
items.remediation: Set the attribute `storage_encrypted = true` in `aws_neptune_cluster.default`. Optionally specify `kms_key_arn` to use a customer-managed KMS key.

scores.reason: Correct resource and attribute; setting storage_encrypted = true fixes the check, kms_key_arn is optional.
